metaDescription: Order custom fleece ice scrapers for bulk giveaways. Soft liner protects hands. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Fleece-lined ice scrapers add comfort to winter mornings by keeping hands warm while clearing windshields. Unlike standard plastic scrapers, the soft fleece backing prevents cold handle shock and provides a non-slip grip. These are ideal for company holiday gifts, winter safety kits, or employee appreciation packs. Decorate the plastic blade or handle with your logo using pad printing or screen printing for year-round brand visibility.
